custom_logic_notes: Classic martingale EA: doubles lot size after each loss, resets to initial lot after a win. Entry signal is based on simple price comparison (buy if price above previous close, sell if below). The core risk is unbounded position growth - max_lot of 0 means no cap on lot size, making this extremely dangerous in live trading. Margin-dependent: eventually broker margin will prevent further lot increases.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale lot progression requires accurate margin calculation to replicate MT5 behavior. The lot-doubling-after-loss logic depends on trade history (identifying last closed trade result), which needs careful state tracking in Python. Cannot simply use fixed fractional sizing - must implement full trade result tracking and lot progression state machine.
